speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with increasing yellowing of the eyes and skin. To determine the cause of your jaundice, how many hours old were you when this discoloration first became noticeable?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (physiologic jaundice exacerbated by insufficient intake).

Since the baby is two weeks old and exclusively breastfed, I need to check her bilirubin levels and assess her hydration status. REQUEST TEST: Total_Serum_Bilirubin, Direct_Bilirubin. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Ultrasound.
